question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)

calls.reasoning: Reference class: NVIDIA next-quarter revenue guide midpoint / just-reported quarter actual over the last 5 quarters = 1.115-1.145. Q3 actual is likely ~$112-114B, because Q1 and Q2 beat their guidance midpoints by 4.6% and 5.7%. That implies a Q4 guide of about $127B. Analyst consensus for Q4 is ~$124.5B, and NVIDIA guided Q3 ~4% above consensus, which also points to ~$127-129B. Upside: the Rubin ramp and fiscal 2028 consensus near $692B. Downside: supply/memory constraints and the margin trough. Markets: only thin Polymarket contracts on Q3 Data Center revenue (above $105B at 0.49), which differ from this question; used as evidence only.

calls.reconciliation: All three runs share the same evidence and land at medians of 126-127. Factual: the Q1 FY27 guide of $78B (Run 3 had it unconfirmed) is confirmed by Runs 1 and 2 citing the SEC 8-K, so the ratio series 1.14/1.145/1.115/1.123 stands. Factual, unsettled: the ~$124.5B Q4 consensus comes only from search summaries; treated as weak evidence, and NVIDIA's recent guides beat consensus anyway. Judgment: step size. I take ratio ~1.12 on a Q3 actual of ~$113B, median 126.5, and carry forward a 90-10 width of ~9B, between Run 1 and Runs 2-3. Escape masses: 3% low (supply shock/demand pause), 5% high (big Q3 beat plus Rubin acceleration). No web access this run.
